title: 100% creppper block drops
description: this datapack makes creepers all the blocks they break
body:
# 100% Creeper Drops

Tired of having your builds blown up by a random creeper, only to realize half the blocks vanished into thin air? In vanilla Java Edition, explosions randomly destroy a percentage of dropped items, forcing you to grind for materials all over again.

This lightweight, performance-friendly data pack fixes that frustration by matching Bedrock Edition's mechanic: all blocks destroyed by creepers are guaranteed to drop 100% of their items.

### Features

* **Full Item Recovery:** Every single block broken by a creeper explosion drops as an item. Zero lost blocks.
* **Pure Vanilla Feel:** Keeps the danger of creepers damaging your terrain without punishing you with lost resources.
* **Lag-Free:** Built using optimized vanilla loot tables rather than heavy ticking functions or entity scans. Perfect for survival servers.

### Compatibility

* Works seamlessly on singleplayer worlds and multiplayer servers.
* Fully compatible with optimization mods and performance packs.
